learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply practical methods and systematization for parametric and associative modeling of individual parts and assemblies and to derive manufacturing-specific drawings.

syllabus_topics: Creation of assemblies. Linking individual parts in the assembly via assembly constraints.
Drawing derivation of individual parts and assemblies. Views, sections, dimensioning, tolerances, surface specifications and parts lists.

assessment_methods.method: Exam. Sketch-based, parametric modeling of a component and drawing derivation.

assessment_rules: The module examination must be passed to receive credit points. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by credit points.
